body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md. Do not edit that file or specs/001-product-vision/spec.md. Prices below are fictional and labeled source fictional. Do not call a live retailer, bank, or Gemini API in tests. Do not commit secrets. Rails freeze fixtures/**, optimizer, receipts, and prior API tests so this ticket cannot rewrite them. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Add POST /v1/explain on the existing FastAPI app. Body: line_ids, day, card_product_id, usual_store, store_id. The server runs the optimizer. It does not trust a client-supplied discount.

The model client receives only that plan JSON plus an instruction that every number must already appear in the JSON. After the client returns text, drop any token that introduces a number absent from the plan JSON. If the plan discount digits are missing from the remaining text, append a sentence Legal saving: <discount> LKR. using the optimizer value.

tests/test_explain.py uses a fake client that returns You save 99999. The response text contains the real discount digits and does not contain 99999.

Day shape and fixtures are the ones SC-002 committed. Use fixtures/baskets/capped.json, weekday saturday, date 2026-10-17, store_id keells. The discount in that response is 1000.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The explanation contains the discount and no other number. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_explain.py::test_explanation_includes_discount_and_no_other_numbers -q
title: Explain a plan using only optimizer numbers
